verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents AI extraction through `ai_query` and `ai_extract_rules`, so choosing the extraction model is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the pack shows a way to point that extraction at a local or self-hosted LLM: no bring-your-own-model, custom endpoint, or model-selection parameter. The community comments about running scrapers locally describe user-side alternatives, not a product capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug in a local or self-hosted LLM as the extraction backend instead of a cloud-only model
